title: Only a third of stocks beat the market on results day.
dek: Even companies that grew profit 75% or more beat the index on the day after results only 46% of the time. The market wanted more than growth.

chart.title: % of stocks that beat the index on the first trading day after results
chart.sub: grouped by profit growth, Q2 FY27 vs Q2 FY26

legend.b: Beat the index 35–49% of the time

stats.label: Beat the index, all results
stats.note: 943 of 2,776 stocks outperformed the index on day one; the median stock lagged by 1.3%.

stats.label: Profit up 75% or more
stats.note: Strong growth barely tilted the odds: median day-one move -0.3% vs the index (387 stocks).

stats.label: Profit down 25% or more
stats.note: Misses were punished: median day-one move -2.5% vs the index (489 stocks).

read: This season the bar was set before the numbers came out: misses were sold hard, and big beats were mostly already in the price.
sources: Vantage analysis of Q2 FY27 results filed on BSE and NSE/BSE closing prices, as of 18 Nov 2026
notes: Day-one reaction = the stock's move from the close before results to the close on the first trading day after, minus the benchmark index's move over the same day. Profit growth is net profit, Q2 FY27 vs Q2 FY26; companies with no profit comparison are left out of the groups but counted in the overall share. Banks are excluded. Past reactions say nothing about future returns.
